title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Teodora Hercla

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova  na izgradnji distributivne toplovodne mreže u ulici Teodora Hercla u periodu od 30.09. do 13.12.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the works on the construction of the distribution hot water network in Teodora Herzla Street in the period from September 30. until 13.12.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu u ulici Teodora Hercla, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Novogradska do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Tošin bunar (raskrsnica ulica Tošin bunar i Teodora Hercla biće slobodna za saobraćaj), pri čemu će predmetna deonica biti zatvorena za saobraćaj, zbog čega će linije JLPP-a saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the roadway in Teodora Herzla Street, in the section from the intersection zone with Novogradska Street to the intersection zone with Tošin Bunar Street (the intersection of Tošin Bunar and Teodora Herzla Streets will be free for traffic), whereby the section in question will be closed to traffic, which is why the JLPP lines will operate as follows:

sections.text: - vozila sa linije br. 15 će u oba smera saobraćati ulicama Vrtlarska, Ugrinovačka, Gornjogradska, Prvomajska i dalje redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 15 will run in both directions on the streets Vrtlarska, Ugrinovačka, Gornjogradska, Prvomajska and further along the regular route;

sections.text: - vozila sa linija br. 18, 78 i 15N će u oba smera saobraćati ulicama Tošin Bunar, Ivićeva, Ugrinovačka, Gornjogradska, Prvomajska i dalje redovnim trasama;

text_translations.en: - vehicles from line no. 18, 78 and 15N will run in both directions on the streets Tošin Bunar, Ivićeva, Ugrinovačka, Gornjogradska, Prvomajska and further on regular routes;

sections.text: Vozila će na izmenjenom delu koristiti sva postojeća stajališta JLPP-a,kao i novouspostavljena privremena autobuska stajališta i to:

text_translations.en: Vehicles on the modified section will use all existing JLPP stops, as well as the newly established temporary bus stops, namely:

sections.text: U smeru prema Zemunu:

text_translations.en: In the direction of Zemun:

sections.text: -  „Gornjogradska 1“ - stajalište se uspostavlja u ulici Gornjogradska na poziciji drugog ED stuba koji se nalazi ispred kućnog broja 63, odnosno oko 60 metara posle zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Ugrinovačka;

text_translations.en: - "Gornjogradska 1" - the bus stop is established in Gornjogradska street at the position of the second ED pillar located in front of house number 63, that is, about 60 meters after the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka street;

sections.text: - „Prvomajska 1“ - stajalište se uspostavlja u ulici Gornjogradska, na poziciji ED stuba stuba koji se nalazi u visini kućnog broja 10,odnosno oko 60 metara ispred zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Prvomajska;

text_translations.en: - "Prvomajska 1" - the stop is established in Gornjogradska Street, at the position of the ED pillar of the pillar located at the height of house number 10, that is, about 60 meters in front of the intersection zone with Prvomajska Street;

sections.text: U smeru prema gradu:

text_translations.en: Towards the city:

sections.text: - „Prvomajska 1“ - stajalište se uspostavlja u ulici Gornjogradska, na poziciji ED stuba stuba koji se nalazi u visini kućnog broja 2, odnosno oko 40 metara posle zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Prvomajska.

text_translations.en: - "Prvomajska 1" - the stop is established in Gornjogradska Street, at the position of the ED pillar of the pillar located at the height of house number 2, that is, about 40 meters after the intersection zone with Prvomajska Street.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji mostovske konstrukcije u ulici Đorđa Stanojevića

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na izgradnji kompleksa stanice Novi Beograd sa rekonstrukcijom mostovske konstrukcije u ulicama Antifašističke borbe i Đorđa Stanojevića. Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the construction of the Novi Beograd station complex with the reconstruction of the bridge structure in the streets of Antifašističke borba and Đorđe Stanojevića. The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza 2 -  Radovi se izvode na kolovozu ulice Đorđa Stanojevića u visini želzničkog nadvožnjaka, u periodu od 23.09. do 15.12.2026. godine. Tokom izvođenja radova doći će do zatvaranje predmetne deonica za saobraćaj, pri čemu će linije javnog prevoza saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: Phase 2 - Works are being carried out on the roadway of Đorđa Stanojevića Street at the height of the railway overpass, in the period from 23.09. until 15.12.2026. year. During the execution of the works, the section in question will be closed to traffic, with public transport lines operating as follows:

sections.text: • Tramvajske linije br. 7L, 9L i 13 se privremeno ukidaju;

text_translations.en: • Tram lines no. 7L, 9L and 13 are temporarily suspended;

sections.text: • Privremeno se uspostavlja tramvajska linija 7L1 koja će saobraćati na relaciji Ustanička - Pogon „Sava“ preko Mosta na Adi;

text_translations.en: • Tram line 7L1 is temporarily being established, which will operate on the route Ustanička - Pogon "Sava" via the Bridge on Ada;

sections.text: • Privremeno se uspostavlja tramvajska linija 9L1 koja će saobraćati na relaciji Banjica - Pogon „Sava“ preko Mosta na Adi;

text_translations.en: • Tram line 9L1 is temporarily established, which will operate on the route Banjica - Pogon "Sava" via the Ada Bridge;

sections.text: • Privremeno se uspostavlja autobuska kružna linija br. 7A koja će saobraćati od Bloka 45 ulicama: terminus „Blok 45“, Dr Ivana Ribara, Jurija Gagarina, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Marka Hristića, Jurija Gagarina, Antifašitičke borbe, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Milentije Popovića,  Bulevar Mihajla Pupina, kružni tok kod TC „Ušće“, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina, Milentije Popovića, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Antifašističke borbe, Jurija Gagarina, Marha Hristića, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Jurija Gagarina, Dr Ivana Ribara do terminusa „Blok 45“;

text_translations.en: • A temporary circular bus line no. 7A, which will run from Blok 45 through the following streets: terminus "Blok 45", Dr. Ivan Ribar, Jurija Gagarin, Red Army Boulevard, Marko Hristić, Jurij Gagarin, Antifascist Struggle, Milutin Milankovića Boulevard, Milentije Popovića Boulevard, Mihajlo Pupina Boulevard, roundabout near TC "Ušće", Mihajlo Pupina Boulevard, Milentije Popovića Boulevard, Milutinja Popovića Boulevard, Anti-fascist struggles, Yuri Gagarin, Marho Hristić, Boulevard of the Red Army, Yuri Gagarin, Dr. Ivan Ribar to terminus "Block 45";

sections.text: • Vozila sa linije EKO 1 će u smeru ka naselju „Belvil“, saobraćati ulicama: Antifašističke borbe, Jurija Gagarina, Marka Hristića, Bulevar Crvene Armije i dalje redovnom trasom, dok će u suprotnom smeru saobraćati redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: • Vehicles from the EKO 1 line will travel in the direction of the "Belville" neighborhood on the streets: Anti-Fascist Struggles, Yuri Gagarin, Marko Hristić, Bulevar Crvena Armija and further along the regular route, while in the opposite direction they will travel along the regular route;

sections.text: • Vozila sa linije 600 će u oba smeru, saobraćati ulicama: Most na Adi, Jurija Gagarina, Antifašističke borbe, Milutina Milankovića, Španskih boraca i dalje redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: • Vehicles from line 600 will travel in both directions on the streets: Most na Ada, Yuri Gagarin, Anti-Fascist Struggle, Milutin Milanković, Spanish Fighters and further along the regular route;

sections.text: Vozila će koristiti sva postojeća stajališta, kao i novouspostavljena privremna stajališta:

text_translations.en: Vehicles will use all existing stops, as well as newly established temporary stops:

sections.text: - „Bulevar Crvene Armije 1“ u ulici Bulevar Crvene Armije na lokaciji koja se nalazi oko 90 metara posle zone raskrsnice ulice Bulevar Crvene Armije i Jurija Gagarina, odnosno u visini objekta „Delta city“. Predmetno stajalište će korsititi linija br. 7A;

text_translations.en: - "Bulevar Crvene Armije 1" in Bulevar Crvene Armije Street at a location located about 90 meters after the intersection zone of Bulevar Crvene Armije Street and Yuri Gagarin Street, i.e. at the height of the "Delta City" building. The stop in question will be used by line no. 7A;

sections.text: - „Depo Sava“ u ulici Đorđa Stanojevića na lokaciji koja se nalazi oko 30 metara ispred zone raskrsnice ulice Đorđa Stanojevića i Marka Hristića, odnosno u visini pogona „Depo Sava“. Predmetno stajalište će korsititi linija br. 7A i 18N;

text_translations.en: - "Depo Sava" in Đorđe Stanojevića Street at a location located about 30 meters in front of the intersection of Đorđe Stanojevića and Marko Hristića Streets, i.e. at the height of the "Depo Sava" facility. The stop in question will be used by line no. 7A and 18N;

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Dunavska - Faza 2

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Dunavska - Faza 2, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Tadeuša Košćuškog (raskrsnica zatvorena za saobraćaj) do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Dubrovačka u periodu od 29.09. godine do 04.10.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works on Dunavska Street - Phase 2, on the part from the intersection zone with Tadeuša Košćuški Street (intersection closed to traffic) to the intersection zone with Dubrovačka Street in the period from 29.09. until 04.10.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zatvaranje desne strane kolovoza ulice Dunavska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Tadeuša Košćuškog (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu) do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Dubrovačka (gledano u smeru ka ulici Dubrovačka), pri čemu će se preostala širina kolovoza koristiti za dvosmerno odvijanje saobraćaja.

text_translations.en: The works involve the closing of the right side of the Dunavska Street roadway in the part from the intersection zone with Tadeuša Košćuški Street (including the intersection itself) to the intersection zone with Dubrovačka Street (seen in the direction of Dubrovačka Street), whereby the remaining width of the roadway will be used for two-way traffic.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova, vozila sa linija br. 26, 26N i 401n će u smeru ka Dorćolu saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Bulevar vojvode Bojovića, Dunavska, Dubrovačka do privremenog polazno/dolaznog stajališta „Dorćol (Dunavska) 1“, koje se nalazi u ulici Dubrovačka, na poziciji niše za parkiranje, neposredno ispred zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Mike Alasa, koja će se u ovom slučaju koristiti kao stajalište javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the works, vehicles from line no. 26, 26N and 401n in the direction of Dorćol will travel along the streets Cara Dušan, Bulevar vojvoda Bojovića, Dunavska, Dubrovačka to the temporary departure/arrival stop "Dorćol (Dunavska) 1", which is located on Dubrovačka Street, at the position of the parking niche, immediately in front of the intersection with Mika Alasa Street, which in this case will be used as a public transport stop.

sections.text: Vozila će na izmenjenom delu trasa koristiti postojeća stajališta.

text_translations.en: Vehicles will use the existing stops on the changed part of the route.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Dunavska Street - Phase 2

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Gandijeva

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Gandijeva u periodu od 20.09. od 13.00 časova  do 02.10.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linije br. 82.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Gandijeva Street in the period from 20.09. from 1:00 p.m. until 02.10.2026. there will be changes in the operation of line no. 82.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu ulice Gandijeva, na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Pere Segedinca do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Partizanske avijacije. Tokom izvođenja radova, predmetna deonica će biti zatvorena za saobraćaj, pri čemu će doći do promene u radu linija JLPP-a br. 82 i to:

text_translations.en: The works are being carried out on the roadway of Gandijeva street, on the part from the intersection zone with Pere Segedinca street to the intersection zone with Partizanske avijacije street. During the execution of the works, the section in question will be closed to traffic, and there will be a change in the operation of JLPP lines no. 82 and that:

sections.text:
Smer ka Bloku 44:
Linija će saobraćati ulicama Tošin bunar, Nikole Dobrovića, Marka Čelebonovića, Norveška, Ljubinke Bobić, Partizanske avijacije, Nikole Dobrovića, Tošin bunar, Egipatska, Gandijeva i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en:
Direction to Block 44:
The line will run through the streets Tošin bunar, Nikola Dobrović, Marko Čelebonović, Norveska, Ljubinka Bobić, Partizanska avijacije, Nikola Dobrović, Tošin bunar, Egipatska, Gandijeva and further along the regular route.

sections.text:
Smer ka Zemunu:
Linija će saobraćati ulicama Gandijeva, Egipatska, Tošin bunar, Nikole Dobrovića, Partizanske avijacije, Ljubinke Bobić, Norveška, Marka Čelebonovića, Nikole Dobrovića, Tošin bunar i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en:
Direction to Zemun:
The line will run through the streets Gandijeva, Egipatska, Tošin bunar, Nikola Dobrović, Partizanska avijacije, Ljubinka Bobić, Norvegia, Marko Čelebonović, Nikola Dobrović, Tošin bunar and further along the regular route.

sections.text: U smeru ka Bloku 44, linija će koristiti sva postojeća stajališta, osim stajališta „Nikole Dobrovića“ (smer ka ulici Tošin bunar) i „Generala Nedeljkovića“ (smer ka ulici Tošin bunar).

text_translations.en: In the direction of Block 44, the line will use all existing stops, except for the "Nikola Dobrović" (direction to Tošin Bunar Street) and "General Nedeljković" (direction to Tošin Bunar Street) stops.

sections.text: U smeru ka Zemunu, linija će koristiti sva postojeća stajališta, osim stajališta „Vojvođanska“ (smer ka ulici Norveška) i „Generala Nedeljkovića“ (smer ka ulici Marka Čelebonovića).

text_translations.en: In the direction of Zemun, the line will use all existing stops, except for the stops "Vojvođanska" (direction towards Norveska Street) and "General Nedeljkovića" (direction towards Marko Čelebonovića Street).

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Gandijeva Street

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Kraljice Marije

sections.text: Radovi se produžavaju do 04.10.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: The works are extended until 04.10.2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na redovnom održavanju u ulici Kraljice Marije, na delu od ulaza u javnu garažu do ulaza u garažu u Studentski dom u periodu od 08.09. do 21.09. 2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the performance of regular maintenance works in Kraljice Marije Street, on the part from the entrance to the public garage to the entrance to the garage in the Student Dormitory in the period from 08.09. until 21.09. In 2026, there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju zatvaranje za saobraćaj desne saobraćajne trake ulice Kraljice Marije na delu od ulaza u javnu garažu do ulaza u garažu u Studentski dom (smer ka ulici Bulevar kralja Aleksandra) u širini od 2,5 metra.

text_translations.en: The works involve closing the right traffic lane of Kraljica Marije Street to traffic in the section from the entrance to the public garage to the entrance to the garage in the Student Dorm (direction towards Bulevar Kralja Aleksandra Street) in a width of 2.5 meters.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja predmetnih radova, ulica Kraljice Marije u visini zone radova će biti dvosmerna za saobraćaj (širina saobraćajnih traka 3,5 i 4,0 metra), pri čemu će biti onemogućeno korišćenje polazno/dolaznog stajališta „Vukov spomenik“ za linije br. 32, 66 i EKO 1.

text_translations.en: During the execution of the works in question, Kraljice Marije street at the height of the work zone will be two-way for traffic (traffic lane width 3.5 and 4.0 meters), whereby it will be impossible to use the exit/arrival stop "Vukov spomenik" for lines no. 32, 66 and ECO 1.

sections.text: Vozila sa linija br. 32 i 66 će kao dolazno stajalište koristiti stajalište „Dalmatinska“ (#551), a kao polazno „Vukov spomenik“ (#64) - oba u ulici Ruzveltova, dok će vozila sa linije EKO 1 kao dolazno koristiti postojeće „Vukov spomenik“ (#64), dok će kao polazno koristiti stajalište „Tehnički fakulteti“ (#585).

text_translations.en: Vehicles from lines no. 32 and 66 will use the "Dalmatinska" (#551) stop as the arrival stop, and "Vukov spomenik" (#64) as the departure stop - both in Ruzveltova Street, while vehicles from the EKO 1 line will use the existing "Vukov spomenik" (#64) stop as the arrival stop, while they will use the "Technical Faculties" (#585) stop as the departure stop.

title_translations.en: Information about the change in the mode of operation of public transport lines during the execution of works in Kraljice Marije Street

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linije javnog prevoza br. 76

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na izgradnji fekalne i kišne kanalizacije u ulici Autoput za Zagreb (Novi Beograd) - Faze 3 i 4 u periodu od 17.09. do 30.09.2026. godine doći će do promena u radu linije javnog prevoza br. 76.

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the construction of fecal and storm sewers in Autoput za Zagreb street (Novi Belgrade) - Phases 3 and 4 in the period from 17.09. until 30.09.2026. there will be changes in the operation of public transport line no. 76.

sections.text: Radovi podrazumevaju iskop rova u kolovozu ulice Autoput za Zagreb na delu od benzinske pumpe „NIS Petrol“ do zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Smolućska (leva strana gledano ka ulici Smolućska), pri čemu će vozila sa linije br. 76 saobraćati u oba smera ulicom Dr Žorža Matea do okretnice „Bežanijska kosa“, bez svraćanja pored JKP „Zelenilo Beograd“.

text_translations.en: The works include the digging of a trench in the roadway of the Autoput za Zagreb street in the section from the gas station "NIS Petrol" to the intersection with Smolućska Street (left side looking towards Smolućska Street), whereby vehicles from line no. 76 drive in both directions along Dr. Žorža Matea street to the "Bežanijska kosa" turnpike, without stopping by the PUK "Zelenilo Beograd".

title_translations.en: Information on the change of mode of operation of public transport line no. 76

title: Informacija o radovima u ulici Vojvođanska /deonica 3/ - Faza 1

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja Faze 1 radova na asfaltiranju i uređenju Ulice Vojvođanska (GO Surčin) - deonica 3, na delu od ulice Šekspirova do ulice Konstantina Danila, u periodu 16.09. do 12.10.2026. godine, doći će do izmena u funkcionisanju javnog prevoza.

text_translations.en: During the execution of Phase 1 of works on asphalting and landscaping of Vojvođanska Street (GO Surčin) - section 3, on the part from Šekspirova Street to Konstantina Danilo Street, in the period 16.09. until 12.10.2026. year, there will be changes in the functioning of public transport.

sections.text: Faza 1 - Tokom izvođenja radova na kolovozu u ulici Surčinska, na delu od ulice Šekspirova do ulice Konstantina Danila, doći će do zauzeća krajnje leve saobraćajne trake (gledano u smeru ka gradu) i trotoara. Vozila JLPP-a će se u zoni radova kretati slobodnom širinom kolovoza uz naizmenično propuštanje regulisano privremenim semaforima i saobraćajnim znakovima.

text_translations.en: Phase 1 - During the works on the road in Surčinska Street, on the part from Šekspirova Street to Konstantina Danilo Street, the far left traffic lane (viewed in the direction of the city) and the sidewalk will be occupied. JLPP vehicles will move in the work zone on the free width of the roadway with alternating passing regulated by temporary traffic lights and traffic signs.

sections.text: Prilikom izvođenja radova u fazi 1, privremeno se izmešta autobusko stajališta i to:

text_translations.en: During the performance of works in phase 1, the bus stop is temporarily relocated, namely:

sections.text: - „Vila Mara“ (smer ka gradu) u ulici Surčinska na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 70 metara posle zone raskrnice sa ulicom Konstantina Danila, odnosno oko 190 metara posle (unapred) redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: - "Vila Mara" (direction towards the city) in Surčinska Street to a position located about 70 meters after the intersection zone with Konstantina Danilo Street, i.e. about 190 meters after the (advance) regular position.

sections.text: - „Vila Mara“ (smer ka Jakovu) u ulici Surčinska na poziciju koja se nalazi oko 30 metara ispred zone raskrnice sa ulicom Konstantina Danila, odnosno oko 50 metara ispred (unazad) redovne pozicije.

text_translations.en: - "Vila Mara" (direction towards Jakov) in Surčinska Street to a position located about 30 meters in front of the intersection zone with Konstantina Danilo Street, i.e. about 50 meters in front (backwards) of the regular position.

title_translations.en: Information about works in Vojvođanska street /section 3/ - Phase 1

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na državnom putu IIA-147

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na sanaciji otcepljenja trupa državnog puta IIA-147 (ul. Kosmajska) u Mladenovvcu, u periodu od 22.09. do 01.04.2027. godine doći će do promena u radu linije JLPP-a.

text_translations.en: During the performance of works on the repair of the separation of the trunk of the state road IIA-147 (Kosmajska Street) in Mladenovvac, in the period from September 22. until 01.04.2027. there will be changes in the operation of the JLPP line.

sections.text: Radovi se izvode na kolovozu državnog puta IIA-147 (ul. title: Informacija o promeni režima saobraćaja i režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova na uklanjanju Starog savskog mosta

sections.text:
• Tramvajske linije br. 7 i 9 će u oba smera, od zone Savskog trga saobraćati ulicama Savska, Bulevar vojvode Mišića, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Adi, Bulevar heroja sa Košara, Bulevar Crvene Armije, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Antifašističke borbe i dalje redovno do Bloka 45 i nosiće oznake 7L i 9L.
• Uspostavlja se privremena autobuska linija br. 9A (Trg Slavija - Blok 45)  koja će u intervalu od 12  minuta pokrivati deo trase kojim neće ići tramvaji (Bulevar Milutina Milankovića, Milentija Popovića i Sajmište) i trasa linije 9A biće: Trg Slavija, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov most, privremena devijacija na ulicu Ušće, Ušće (Bulevar Mihajla Pupina u smeru ka gradu), Sajmište, Zemunski put, tramvajskom bašticom do ulice Milentija Popovića i dalje redovno trasama tramvajskih linija do Bloka 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 i 83 su počev od 04. oktobra zbog izvođenja pripremnih radova i oštećenja na Starom savskom mostu preusmerene na trasu Brankovim mostom i saobraćaju ulicama: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa (Admirala Geprata u smeru ka Banjici odnosno Crvenom krstu), Pop Lukina, Brankov most, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje redovno do Zemuna. 
• Vozila će na izmenjenim delovima trasa koristiti postojeća kao i novouspostavljena privremena stajališta „Kamenička 1“ i „Brankov most 1“ za linije br. 9A, 78 i 83 - smer prema Trgu Slavija, odnosno „Staro sajmište“ - smer prema Bloku 45 za liniju br. 9A.

text_translations.en:
• Tram lines no. 7 and 9 will run in both directions, from the area of ​​Sava Square, through the streets of Savska, Bulevar Vojvode Mišić, Petlja "Radnička", Most na Ada, Bulevar Herojas sa Košar, Bulevar Crvena Armija, Bulevar Milutin Milankovića, Bulevar Antifascistke Borbe and continue regularly to Block 45 and will carry signs 7L and 9L.
• A temporary bus line no. 9A (Trg Slavija - Block 45), which will cover the part of the route on which trams will not run (Milutin Milanković Boulevard, Milentija Popovića and Sajmište) and the route of line 9A will be: Slavija Square, Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrila Principa, Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, temporary deviation to Ušće Street, Ušće (Mihajla Pupina Boulevard in the direction of the city), Sajmište, Zemunski put, by tram garden to Milentija Popovića Street and further by regular tram routes to Block 45. 
• Autobuske linije br. 78 and 83 have been diverted since October 4 due to preparatory works and damage to the Old Sava Bridge to the Brankov Most route and traffic on the streets: Nemanjina, Balkanska, Gavrilo Principa (Admiral Geprato in the direction of Banjica, i.e. the Red Cross), Pop Lukina, Brankov Most, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and further regularly to Zemun. 
• Vehicles will use the existing as well as the newly established temporary stops "Kamenička 1" and "Brankov most 1" for lines no. 9A, 78 and 83 - direction towards Trg Slavija, i.e. "Staro sajmište" - direction towards Block 45 for line no. 9A.

title: Informacija o promeni režima rada linija javnog prevoza tokom izvođenja radova u ulici Banatska

sections.text: Radovi u okviru faze 2 produženi su do 30.09.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Works within phase 2 have been extended until September 30, 2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova na instalaciji fekalne kanalizacije u ulici Banatska (Zemun) doći će do promena u radu linija javnog prevoza. Radovi će se izvoditi po fazama i to:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works on the installation of fecal sewage in Banatska Street (Zemun), there will be changes in the operation of public transport lines. The works will be carried out in phases, namely:

sections.text: Faza 4 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 07.05. do 27.05.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 4 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (including the intersection itself) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 07.05. until 27.05.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 4a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Somborska (slobodna raskrsnica) do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Ugrinovačka. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 28.05. do 12.06.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 4a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic on the part from the intersection zone with Somborska Street (free intersection) to the intersection zone with Ugrinovačka Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 28.05. until 12.06.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 3 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Niška do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Somborska. Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 13.06. do 15.07.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 3 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street for traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Niška Street to the intersection zone with Somborska Street. Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 13.06. until 15.07.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 2a - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Cara Dušana do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Niška (uključujući i samu raskrsnicu). Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 16.07. do 05.08.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 2a - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (including the intersection itself). Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 16.07. until 05.08.2026. year.

sections.text: Faza 2 - radovi u ovoj fazi podrazumevaju potpuno zatvaranje za saobraćaj ulice Banatska na delu od zone raskrsnice sa ulicom Cara Dušana do zone raskrsnice  sa ulicom Niška (slobodna raskrsnica). Radovi u ovoj fazi će se izvoditi u periodu od 06.08. do 01.09.2026. godine.

text_translations.en: Phase 2 - works in this phase involve the complete closure of Banatska Street to traffic in the part from the intersection zone with Cara Dušana Street to the intersection zone with Niška Street (free intersection). Works in this phase will be carried out in the period from 06.08. until 01.09.2026. year.

sections.text: Tokom izvođenja radova u svim fazama vozila javnog prevoza će saobraćati na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: During the execution of works in all phases, public transport vehicles will operate as follows:

sections.text: Linija br. 85 će u smeru ka Banovom brdu saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Ugrinovačka i dalje redovno, dok će u smeru ka Borči saobraćati ulicama Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most i dalje redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: Line no. 85 in the direction of Banovo brdo will continue to travel through the streets of Cara Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Ugrinovačka and continue regularly, while in the direction of Borča it will continue through the streets of Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spojna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most and continue along the regular route;

sections.text: Linije br. 103, 105L i 112 će u smeru ka terminusu „Zemun (Bačka)“ saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Ugrinovačka, Bačka do termunusa „Zemun (Bačka)“, dok će u smeru ka Borči i Ovči saobraćati od terminusa „Zemun (Bačka)“ ulicama  Bačka, Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Pupinov most i dalje redovnim trasama;

text_translations.en: Line no. 103, 105L and 112 in the direction of the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)" will travel along the streets of Cara Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Ugrinovačka, Bačka to the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)", while in the direction of Borča and Ovča they will travel from the terminus "Zemun (Bačka)" through the streets Bačka, Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, External main tangent, Pupinov bridge and still regular routes;

sections.text: Linija br. 612 će u smeru ka Novom Beogradu saobraćati ulicama Cara Dušana, Filipa Višnjića, Rada Končara i dalje redovno dok će u smeru ka Novoj Galenici saobraćati ulicama Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spoljna magistralna tangenta, Cara Dušana i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Line no. 612 in the direction of New Belgrade will continue to run on the streets of Car Dušan, Filip Višnjić, Rad Končar, while in the direction of Nova Galenica it will continue to run on the streets of Ugrinovačka, Autoput za Novi Sad, Spojna magistralna tangenta, Car Dušan and on the regular route.
